cawsRules.ruleText: Do not harvest the student's body (no sexual pressure)
Your mouth must lift, not break (no humiliation)
You must say when you don't know
Do not steal teaching from another
Do not threaten a learner's future
Speak truth about opportunity cost and dangers
Do not expose private pain in public class
Bless the ones you raise (knowledge must travel)

dashboardLayout.welcomeMessage: Teacher of Minds, {studentsWaiting} youths wait for you before exam. {privateRequests} asked for safe advice. Your voice is needed. Guard it with honor.
